sets.relationshipLabel: a thing and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: A puppet has a mouth and a stage has a curtain — each is just a part its whole always possesses.

sets.relationshipLabel: a kind of puppet and a famous individual example of it
sets.explanation: Pinocchio is the famous marionette and Lamb Chop the famous sock puppet — each pair names a puppet style and its best-known star.

sets.relationshipLabel: a worker and the tool of their craft
sets.explanation: A puppeteer works a rod and a ventriloquist works a dummy — each is the instrument that defines their act.

sets.relationshipLabel: a creature and the puppet-form made to depict it
sets.explanation: Dragons are conventionally staged as shadow puppets and witches as hand puppets — a fixed convention, not a necessity, which is what makes it the hardest link on the board.
